final: WITH t AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM expense WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_budget), a AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM t) SELECT AVG(t.total) AS avg_total_above, SUM(t.n) AS total_expenses, AVG(t.total - a.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM t, a WHERE t.total > a.avg_total
